body_markdown:
SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Nov. 4, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc. (NASDAQ: IDYA), a precision medicine oncology company committed to the discovery and development of targeted therapeutics, today announced its participation in the upcoming investor relations events.


UBS Global Biopharma Conference
Monday, November 16, 2026 | 10:40 AM GMT (5:40 AM EST) | London, United Kingdom


- Fireside chat with Yujiro S. Hata, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. The discussion will be hosted by Michael Yee, Global Head of Biotechnology Research and Managing Director, Senior Biotechnology and Pharma Analyst.


IDEAYA Biosciences Investor R&D Day
Monday, November 16, 2026 | 5:00 PM GMT (12:00 PM EST) | London, United Kingdom


The event will provide an overview of:


- IDE892, a potential best-in-class MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, including Phase 1 dose escalation clinical data summary of pharmacokinetics, safety, and human plasma SDMA pharmacodynamics
- RAS progress, including breakthroughs, emerging data, and future challenges
- Preclinical data supporting IDEAYA's broad clinical combination strategies targeting MTAP/CDKN2A and RAS-driven PDAC, NSCLC, and CRC, including IDE892 (PRMT5, Phase 1) in RAS-mutant PDAC, CDKN2A (target IND in H1 2027) in RAS-mutant PDAC and NSCLC, and IDE574 (KAT6/7, Phase 1) to intercept epigenetic alterations that drive resistance in RAS-mutant CRC and NSCLC
- Target 2027 clinical data updates and milestones in MTAP/CDKN2A and KRAS, including PRMT5 and pan-RAS clinical combination


The event will feature Dr. Frank McCormick of the UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center.


Advance registration is required for both in-person and virtual attendance. To register, please visit:[https://lifescievents.com/event/izl51pw/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813817-1&h=1572346152&u=https%3A%2F%2Flifescievents.com%2Fevent%2Fizl51pw%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Flifescievents.com%2Fevent%2Fizl51pw%2F)


Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 | 1:00 PM GMT (8:00 AM EST) | London, United Kingdom


- Fireside chat with Yujiro S. Hata, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer; Michael White, President of Research and Development; and Joshua Bleharski, Chief Financial Officer. The discussion will be hosted by Maury Raycroft, Ph.D. Equity Research Analyst, Biotechnology.


A live audio webcast of the events will be available under the "Investors/Events" section of the IDEAYA website at[https://ir.ideayabio.com/events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813817-1&h=453654277&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ideayabio.com%2Fevents&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ideayabio.com%2Fevents) and/or through the conference host. A replay of the webcasts will be accessible for 30 days following the live events.


**About IDEAYA Biosciences**


IDEAYA is a precision medicine oncology company committed to the discovery, development, and commercialization of transformative therapies for cancer. Our approach integrates expertise in small-molecule drug discovery, structural biology and bioinformatics with robust internal capabilities in identifying and validating translational biomarkers to develop tailored, potentially first-in-class targeted therapies aligned to the genetic drivers of disease. We have built a deep pipeline of product candidates focused on synthetic lethality and antibody-drug conjugates, or ADCs, for molecularly defined solid tumor indications. Our mission is to bring forth the next wave of precision oncology therapies that are more selective, more effective, and deeply personalized with the goal of altering the course of disease and improving clinical outcomes for patients with cancer.
